actions_taken: Ran the paid buyer in child process 13639, persisted payment state, and terminated it with SIGKILL.
Started cold buyer process 13640 with only the persisted SQLite state and seller URL.
Implemented authoritative tasks/get polling with receipt and taskId verification on every response; wake notifications are ignored as state.
Implemented an operator fixture that atomically binds artifact ID, URL, and order reference before completed status.
Implemented buyer verification of artifact presence and payment-order correlation.
Added rejection tests for null artifact URL, mismatched artifact order reference, and mismatched polling receipt.
Captured a redacted cold-restart trace with the bearer taskId replaced by its SHA-256 hash.
key_results: A different cold process resumed successfully from SQLite after SIGKILL and required no in-memory state from the paid process.
tasks/get was polled three times and was the only authoritative lifecycle source; a fabricated completed notification was treated only as a wake hint.
The same payment receipt survived every valid poll because the seller explicitly preserved it; the specifications do not require that behavior.
A controlled receipt mismatch produced RECEIPT_CORRELATION_MISMATCH.
Completion with a null artifact URL was rejected at both seller and buyer boundaries.
The buyer accepted the artifact only when orderReference matched receipt reference pi_p4_cold_restart.

assumptions_made.assumption: Task notifications are wake-up hints only; tasks/get is authoritative after every wake and timer.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: MCP Tasks normatively makes a notification authoritative without a confirming tasks/get.

assumptions_made.assumption: A tool-specific artifact orderReference equal to the Stripe receipt reference is sufficient end-to-end order correlation.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: A standard MCP/MPP paid-artifact identity or correlation model is ratified.

scope_creep_surfaced: P4 used the deterministic fake Stripe boundary because P3 already proved the live test-mode payment path; no second live PaymentIntent was created.
No task notification transport was built. A fabricated notification was injected as a wake hint to prove it cannot override tasks/get.
No refund, cancellation, capability revocation, or production artifact storage was implemented.
next_phase_readiness_reason: The direct lifecycle is green with cold restart and correlation evidence. P5 may evaluate TrueForge trace coverage before adding a separate gateway, but only after the literal token go.
